name: Our Last Halloween
source:
'Our Last Halloween' follows 3 teens attending a Halloween house party. But everything is not as it seems. Play as each character as they encounter a different supernatural event, and see if you can keep everyone alive until daybreak.

[From [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.HamdosArtGames.OurLastHalloween]Google Play Games[/url]]
translation:
《我们的最后一个万圣节》讲述了3名青少年参加万圣节家庭聚会的故事。但一切并不像看上去的那样。扮演每个角色，他们会遇到不同的超自然事件，看看你是否能让每个人都活到黎明。

[来自[url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.HamdosArtGames.OurLastHalloween]Google Play游戏[/url]]
